events.title: El Dia de Los Muertos Craft and Cultural Tasting

cases.refreshed: Generously sponsored by the Friends of the Cambrian Branch Library. Join us in celebrating Dia de los Muertos with Felicia and Gustavo, who will be presenting a craft where they can create their own Day of the Dead altar and they will be able to try some culturally relevant foods related to the celebration! Thank you to Felicia and Gustavo who have offered their time and hard work to make this a very festive occasion for the little ones! Free! First-come, first-served during the event.

cases.refreshed: The Historic Orchard is a 3.3-acre site planted in 1994 and located in Guadalupe Gardens just south of Taylor Street, adjacent to the Heritage Rose Garden and River Park trails. In the 1930s and '40s almost everyone who lived here was engaged in the business of fruit production: growing, picking, packing, canning, selling, or otherwise supporting the industry. Today, with very few orchards remaining, this is a place where adults and children can come to experience a piece of local history. Fruit harvested from the Historic Orchard is donated to Second Harvest of Silicon Valley and local shelters. Help us maintain the River Park's Historic Orchard including: - tree planting and pruning- disease diagnosis and treatment- sun scald prevention painting- sheet mulching- experimenting with different types of irrigation or ground cover- grafting for improved pollination Chaperones are required for those age 15 and younger. School groups or corporate teams must contact the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteer@grpg.org to schedule events. Restrooms are available at the Rotary Play Garden and will require staff assistance. Address for Parking: 438 Coleman Ave. Jose, CA 95110 Meeting Location: Historic Orchard (Refer to registration form for map) Time: 9:30 AM - 11:30 AM Recurring Dates: Every Wednesday

cases.refreshed: Help us revitalize the largest public rose collection in the Western Hemisphere! Tasks include weeding, deadheading/pruning, and seasonal planting. We suggest bringing: - A full water bottle - Thick work gloves Chaperones are required for those age 15 and younger. School groups or corporate teams must contact the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteer@grpg.org to schedule events. Restrooms are available at the Rotary Play Garden starting at 10 AM. We highly recommend using the restrooms prior to volunteering. Address for Parking: 438 Coleman Ave. Jose, CA 95110 Meeting Location: Rose Garden Shed (Refer to registration form for map) Time: 8:30 AM - 11:30 AM Recurring Dates: Every Saturday

You'll have the chance to learn and practice a wide range of seasonal tasks, including planting, weeding, deadheading, mulching, irrigation, pruning, and more—all while giving a little love back to the beautiful Guadalupe Gardens. We suggest bringing: A full water bottle Thick work gloves Chaperones are required for those age 15 and younger. School groups or corporate teams must contact the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteer@grpg.org to schedule events.
